Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When Shen Nong sees the patients, add a visible sign of their illness, such as “病人捂着肚子，脸色很差。”
2. After he suspects the plants, add his worried thought: “这些植物会不会有毒？”
3. When he finds the flowers, describe their appearance to make the discovery vivid: “那些黄色的花像星星一样，又大又漂亮。”

ideas.reason: It adds a clear, appropriate sign of the patients’ illness.
The learner already says that Shennong thinks the plant may be poisonous.
The traditional tale involves tea leaves helping with poison, not finding large yellow flowers.
